subject.title: feat(memory-wiki): add wiki_open_items tool to list unresolved questions and contradictions

question: Should memory-wiki permanently expose unresolved knowledge-health items through a separate `wiki_open_items` tool with the proposed result shape?
rationale: Automated review establishes that the patch is correct, but cannot authorize a new bundled agent-facing product/API contract without owner intent.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this technically sound proposal and reopen or replace it when a memory-wiki owner confirms the permanent API direction.

options.title: Sponsor dedicated tool
options.body: Approve the proposed narrow read API and its current fields as the canonical enumeration contract.

options.title: Request a narrower contract
options.body: Require stable item IDs or consolidation into `wiki_lint` before accepting the feature direction.

recommendation.title: Close until sponsored
recommendation.body: Close this technically sound proposal and reopen or replace it when a memory-wiki owner confirms the permanent API direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc introduced the adjacent claim-health behavior and has the strongest feature-history ownership signal for this decision.
